correctness.rationale: The exact source formula is transformed by the gamma duplication identity. Its logarithmic derivative is 2 log 2 + psi(x+1/2), with strictly positive derivative psi_1. The endpoint value -gamma and divergence of psi give one and only one zero, proving the global minimum and sign pattern. Standard gamma expansions prove both endpoint laws; numerical values are not used as proof.
